data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
DD2: LiteLLM transport for Anthropic + OpenAI paths documented (httpx confirmed)

## Problem
tests/fixtures/ci-review-transport-report.md was captured WITHOUT litellm installed.
The transport detection found urllib.request (stdlib) instead of httpx.
With litellm==1.83.14 installed, the detected transport should be httpx.

## Fix
1. Run: bash tests/skills/run-python-tests.sh (which pip-installs litellm)
2. Run: PYTHONPATH=plugins/dso/scripts pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_transport_verify.py -v
3. Copy the tmp_path/transport-report.md output to tests/fixtures/ci-review-transport-report.md
4. Verify the report contains "httpx" and commit the updated file

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh passes
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] transport-report.md contains "httpx"
  Verify: grep -qi "httpx" tests/fixtures/ci-review-transport-report.md
- [ ] transport-report.md is committed
  Verify: git diff HEAD -- tests/fixtures/ci-review-transport-report.md | wc -l | awk '{exit (>0)}'

## Note on DD3
DD3 PARTIAL finding from verifier was incorrect — anthropic-response.json correctly
contains the raw Anthropic API response format (not the findings schema). The corpus
stores raw provider request/response pairs for parity replay. No action needed for DD3.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
data.title: Update transport-report.md with litellm installed — capture httpx transport detection for DD2
